pcs.pc_description: Coordinate with the Production/ Product development department to identify the demand for different time frames (1 month, 3 months, 6 months, etc.)

Run MRP (Material Requirements Planning) using ERP software and identify the quantity of raw material, components, and semi- finished goods to be procured as per the Bill of Material (BOM) of the products being planned.
Compute the quantum of purchase for different categories of items to be purchased based on priority, lead time and unexpected spikes in demand.
Coordinate with the manager to select the right supplier from the existing pool based on product specifications, quality, cost, and timeline requirements.
Contact the selected suppliers to check on the quantity of orders and their capability to supply.
Contact alternate suppliers in case of inability to make the first selection.
For emergency material requirements, plan the mode of transport and agree on the cost of transport with the supplier.
Prepare the purchase order/indent with all the essential details such as PO numbers, customer contact information, payment information, description, quantity of goods, etc.
Liaise with managers to review and clarify queries about purchase orders/indents.
Send purchase orders to suppliers electronically or via mail after approval from the manager.
Communicate with the supplier and confirm receipt of the PO/indent if an automatic PO is issued using ERP.
Record purchase order details upon approval of the supplier's purchase order.
Clarify suppliers' queries on the PO and make necessary changes, if necessary, with the manager's approval.
Document and maintain purchase reports for different items.
Track the status of requisitions, contracts and orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of goods.
Coordinate with the quality department to inspect the received goods.
Receive a report on the quantity received and quality approved by the supervisor.
Cross-check the order quantity, lot size, packaging and other order parameters as per PO/ indent before generating goods receipt notes for material received from suppliers.
Prepare material return notes for quality rejected items and process returns and claims.
Coordinate with quality, engineering, production, and other teams to resolve material shortages, quality issues, and other discrepancies.
Use ERP for processing Goods Receipt Note (GRN) and Material Return Note (MRN).
Trigger emergency purchases in case of shortage and stop orders for non-moving products or components.
Process invoices by matching them with purchase orders, quantities received and packaging slips to ensure accuracy.
Resolve discrepancies, and ensure that transactions are accurate.
Calculate the amount to be paid based on the terms of payment.
Send invoices along with status reports on the quantity and quality of material received for the manager's approval.
Forward approved invoices to accounts for payment processing.
Communicate invoice processing status and amount to the supplier.
Ensure payments are made within the specific time frame; if not, follow up with the accounts department.

Ensure that all compliance requirements and regulations, such as GST, hazardous goods handling, customs, air and ocean transport requirements, and documentation compliance, are met as per company policy.

pcs.pc_description: Feed and append inventory data received from respective departments into the ERP system.
Make a list of all the inventory with clear details, including item code, item name, unit name, product description, purchase price, sales price, tax code, tracking code, etc.
Prepare MIS report containing Current stock levels, Safety Stock, Inventory Turnover, etc.
Recheck the inventory data to identify any unusual information and take corrective action.
Update inventory items as and when there are changes and Ensure discrepancies between physical and system records are identified and resolved.
Ensure that the inventory is classified as per the type, function and requirements, e.g. Raw Materials, Work-in-Progress (WIP), Finished Goods, Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) Supplies, etc.
Review the current stock levels of each category and check the reorder point (ROP) for each inventory item based on historical demand and lead times.
Using various inventory analysis methods, such as ABC, VED, and FSN analysis, determine the optimum amount of inventory (Economic Order Quantity (EOQ)) to be kept on hand.
Review the inventory on a continuous or periodic basis as pre-decided by the manager.
Submit the analysis to the manager for further review.
Review historical usage, recent stockouts and demand patterns for materials and components.
Determine the period of forecasting based on the manufacturing production cycle, inventory turnover rate, etc., and collect all past demand data.

Choose the right forecasting method, such as qualitative forecasting (Delphi method, historical life cycle analogy) or quantitative forecasting (time series models, exponential smoothing, seasonal indexes), according to business needs and suitability.
Use forecasting models (e.g., moving averages, exponential smoothing) to predict future demand.
Consider factors like production schedules, seasonal variations, and potential supply chain disruptions.
Evaluate both long-term and short-term influencers and outside variables for forecasting.

Perform inventory forecasting techniques as per standard operating procedures, considering both long-term, short-term, and outside variables such as economic growth, seasonality, lifestyle changes, etc.
Compare actual demand against forecasts from multiple angles to identify the variances.
Diagnose the cause of forecast variances, such as inaccurate inventory data, poor forecasting, variability in demand, swings in the economy, etc. and take corrective actions.

pcs.pc_description: Collect information from associates and supervisors regarding loading, unloading, picking, kitting, binning, line feeding, etc., and feed into ERP.
Issue material requests for line usage using ERP.
Obtain information from supervisors and managers regarding priorities, complaints/delays, escalations, supplier complaints, feedback, etc., and feed it into ERP.
Obtain information regarding changes in inventory and feed into ERP.
Review entries made into the ERP with respect to daily plant warehouse operations.

Confirm the Key Metrics and KPIs for Analysis with management, such as Inventory Turnover, Order Fulfillment Lead Time, Stockouts, Backorder Rate, Order Cycle Time, On-Time Delivery (OTD), Production Efficiency, Supplier Performance, etc.

Extract data from the ERP system according to the set KPIs. For example, query the inventory management module in ERP to get data on stock levels and reorder points to calculate inventory turnover rates.
Generate various data such as line stops and rejection data reports, operational complaints related to internal and external stakeholders, etc.
Perform various analyses such as Lead Time Analysis, variance analysis, Backorder and Fulfillment Analysis, etc., as per requirements and present them to management.
Generate various reports, such as Inventory Reports, Procurement Reports, Production Reports, Order Fulfillment Reports, etc., using ERP.
Provide daily reports and periodic reports to management and relevant stakeholders regarding different activities.
Interpret Results and Generate Insights from reports for optimisation and Continuous Improvement.

Update the ERP system with vendor details such as Company name, Address, GST code and information, PAN details, Technical capability, Financial capability, Component/ Part/ Material/Service assigned with (with material/service code), Delivery/INCOTERMS and timeline, Payment terms and timeline, KPI attached with various data and field evaluation, Frequency of vendor performance review, Any other pertinent information.
Cross-check information for data accuracy.
Periodically update the supplier data as per the requirement.
Use manual methods or ERP data analysis to assess vendor performance based on various parameters and the corresponding KPI assigned.
Verify supplier's conformance to organisation's requirements.
Verify supplier's quality management system's conformance to internationally recognised quality management system standards.
Prepare performance rating data sheet for the vendors, incorporate manager's comments, finalize and update/confirm the same in ERP.

pcs.pc_description: Coordinate with the production/product development department to identify the product/ component/ service needs and specific requirement.
Clarify the terms of reference, technical specifications, estimate of budget, volume requirement, planning lead time, and safety stock requirements from the user department.
Prepare purchase specification document indicating the technical, packaging, delivery, performance, safety, handling and commercial specifications required and get it approved by the Manager.
Identify new suppliers based on information from references, online marketplaces, trade magazines, trade fairs, catalogues, referrals, industry events etc.
Solicit information from new and existing vendors on their capability, experience, capacity and technical experience.
Perform an initial evaluation to shortlist suppliers based on basic criteria such as product offerings, quality control/assurance manual, liquidity, capacity, etc. and get it approved by the Manager.
Collect the required information from the user department to draft the RFP (Request for Proposal) or Request for Quotation (RFQ).

Draft the RFP/ RFQ to document the company's needs and the information required from suppliers, such as pricing, delivery schedules, quality guarantees, technical capabilities, prior experience, existing client information, references, financials, etc.

Incorporate details on Product specifications, Order volume estimates, Expected lead times, Quality requirements, Payment terms, Delivery and shipping conditions, commercial requirements, and legal requirements in the RFP.
Discuss the RFP with the user, legal, finance and any other related department and append as per the company's requirements.
Discuss the RFP with the Manager/ Senior Management and get it approved for soliciting bids.
Release RFP to the selected suppliers through hard copy/ email, if required, publish it in technical journals and newspapers to invite bids.
Clarify the queries of interested suppliers during pre-bid meetings and append the RFP if required; publish the changes/ updates to the RFP to all interested suppliers.
Collect proposals from interested suppliers based on the pre-determined proposal deadline.

Perform a technical review of the proposals received in terms of manufacturing/service capability, equipment capacity, technical know-how, prior experience, workforce strength, process capability, quality systems availability, financial capability, track record, etc. to ensure potential suppliers meet the criteria specified in the RFP.
Communicate with suppliers to clarify any information that is missing or unclear in the proposal.
Shortlist potential suppliers based on meeting RFP criteria and disqualify suppliers if they do not meet the specified criteria such as quality specifications, capacity, financial health, etc.
Provide appropriate weightage to various technical parameters, score the technical proposals as per the scoring methodology defined in the RFP.
Submit the proposals to the senior team (manager) for further discussion and shortlisting of suppliers.
Communicate with the shortlisted vendors and invite them for presentation/meeting as per the company's specifications.
Request vendors to submit their best and final price with the corresponding technical workings.

modules.module_title: Support negotiation, costing and contract drafting

pcs.pc_description: Provide appropriate weightage to technical and financial parameters and score the proposals as per the scoring methodology defined in the RFP.
Prepare comparative reports and submit them to the Manager/ Senior Management and clarify their queries during the discussion.
Coordinate proposal reviews and assist in shortlisting suppliers for negotiation of factors such as price, Quality, timelines and volume.
Invite the selected suppliers for negotiation.

Provide supporting Quantitative data, which is especially useful for negotiating prices, delivery schedules, or service levels to management, such as market data, historical purchase orders, and forecasts, to demonstrate why the terms are fair.
Support senior management during the negotiation process and final selection of supplier.

Have a clear idea of alternatives (BATNA – Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement) if the negotiation doesn't go in favour, including sourcing from another supplier, adjusting production plans, or using alternative materials.
Support in the drafting of the contract for the product/component/service with the inputs from user, finance, legal departments and as per company's specifications.
Review the contract document with the Manager/ Senior team, append the contract as per inputs, and get it approved for further processing.
Communicate the contract document with the user, finance, legal and other departments and get it approved.
Facilitate contract signing between the selected supplier and the company representative.
Prepare a work order/ service order after the contract has been awarded to the selected supplier.
Notify other suppliers of the status of the RFP award.
Notify the suppliers on the performance data specification, field evaluation parameters, related KPIs, frequency of measurement and resultant action.

pcs.pc_description: Prepare the vendor performance data KPIs based on adherence to delivery timelines, adherence to quality requirements, timely submission of delivery challans, invoices and other documents, number of user department/ customer complaints, product/ service performance, etc.

Prepare the vendor field evaluation KPIs based on quality management systems, equipment allocated for the process, adherence to process parameters, quality and quantity of workforce deployed, material handling techniques, pest control and material storage training, adherence to safety standards, sustainability, continuous improvement, etc.
Review the KPIs with the manager and get it approved.

Periodically assess the KPIs and its targets as per the company's objectives, vendor's inputs, market trends, and competitor performance and update the same with the approval of the Manager and Senior Management.
Communicate the KPIs with the suppliers periodically and take their concurrence.
Communicate the performance KPIs, planned and unplanned field evaluation methodologies undertaken by the organisation to the suppliers.

Conduct pre-audit research based on inputs of past audit reports, the company's history with the supplier and their products, current product specifications, capacity assigned for the company, quality parameters, contractual requirements, etc.
Collect the necessary quality inspection tools as per the evaluation requirements.
Wear appropriate PPE as per the site to be inspected.
Visit the supplier site and perform a stand- alone analysis of each supplier based on the pre- determined checklist.
Analyse adherence to performance standards as per the requirements of various KPI requirements.
Prepare field evaluation reports as per company standards with the appropriate comments for each KPI.
Prepare field evaluation rating data sheet for the vendors, incorporate manager's comments, finalize and update/confirm the same in ERP.
Prepare field evaluation rating data sheet for the vendors, incorporate manager's comments, finalize and update/confirm the same in ERP
Classify suppliers into similar groups, e.g. by product supplied, industry group, geography of supply, etc.

Establish vendor comparison matrix based on the company's goals and objectives such as quality of supply, cost structure, capabilities, financial health, customer complaints, adherence to timelines, compliance to documentation requirements, process improvement.
Draft the KPI metrics for the above parameters as per the company's requirements, market trends, competitor performance, etc., and get the Manager's inputs and approval.
Prepare a comparative evaluation of suppliers of similar groups as per KPI assigned and rank them in order of performance.
Update vendor performance in ERP with necessary data and analysis.
Communicate the performance rating on a periodic basis to the suppliers.
Provide feedback to suppliers based on the result of the evaluation.
Communicate the results to various internal teams such as product/service, design and development/ engineering, user department, finance, legal, etc.
Provide inputs on supplier management, price negotiation, quality control, commercial terms, vendor continuation/ warning/ termination, etc. based on the reports prepared.
Coordinate with internal teams and suppliers to ensure suppliers undertake corrective mechanisms to improve performance.
Track improvements and update the same in files/ ERP.

pcs.pc_description: Collect complete data of the shipment, including weight, value, type, dimensions, urgency, incoterms, documentation, date of arrival/ transport, origin, destination etc.
Prepare route plans with the networks set up, depending upon the transit time and budget allotted for the shipment.
Check space availability and the cost for different modes of transport.
Collect information about current situations, contingencies like congestion in ports, weather conditions etc. which might affect transit.
Decide on aspects like nearest hubs. It is not necessary that major hubs or gateways be used at all times.
Discuss with the consignee/ stakeholders about the available route options with ETA, cost and other possible hurdles.
Once the route is finalised, book space for each mode of transport using the concerned transport provider's software.
Plan Alternative and additional Transport Corridors according to Customer Needs.
Ensure that Infrastructure and Equipment at transit or connecting point are available.
Confirm that the Operation of cargo / Transshipment at the Transit point is handled according to the customs process.
Make sure that the goods are packed per the transit, transporter, customs etc. requirements and the transit documents, like the Airway bill are fixed properly on the package.
Ensure that the rules and regulations of transhipment according to the ports, transiting hubs, and customs are met while transporting and handling the cargo.
Assess the risks of Political situations, Port Congestion, Strikes, Riot, Backlog of common carriers, unforeseen costs from special handling etc.
Select the Strongest Agents in the planned Corridors.
Prepare transport documents according to the carriers, e.g., contract of carriage, bill of lading etc.
Ensure that tracking devices are added to the shipment and tracking is possible during the entire transit.
Confirm that proper repacking and consolidation happens when switching between modes of transport.
Organize manpower and storage space across disparate facilities.
Use navigational tools integrated with data from weather stations, satellites etc. for analyzing real-time traffic.
Analyse the demand patterns, wait times and historical records to improve efficiency.

Integrate existing transport management systems with AI-powered monitoring tools that identify potential dangers, such as accidents or obstructions, and send automated alerts with alternatives for prompt action.
Ensure cost efficiency by optimising the route and reducing the distance a shipment travels, resulting in less fuel consumption and reduced maintenance costs.

pcs.pc_description: Prepare mandatory documents in ICES such as Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, commercial invoice cum packing list, dock receipt, etc.
Prepare shipping bill and bill of Entry (BoE) for export of goods.
Check the invoice for accuracy regarding the number of packages, quantity, unit rate, total freight on board (FOB) / cost, insurance and freight (CIF) value, etc.
Check for additional documentation and regulatory requirements for Special Cargo (e.g., dangerous goods, livestock, and perishable items).
Attach necessary documents for exports, such as contracts, Letters of Credit, and purchase orders of the overseas buyer.
Prepare a declaration for goods carried in the vessel in case of imports.
Check the manifest for details of the cargo imported, including the quantity and details of discharge port-wise.
Pay the required duty and obtain a copy to be filed.
Coordinate with the Customs Brokers (CBr) and hand over the documents required for customs clearance.
Prepare documentation for special cases such as pilferage, damage of goods, etc., as required.

Input the necessary information into the relevant forms in EDI (e.g., Bill of Entry, Shipping Bill) based on the cargo type, such as Importer/Exporter details; Cargo details (HS Code, description, value); Transport details (Airline, Shipping Line, Bill of Lading number); Tax calculations (Customs Duty, IGST, etc.); Port and Customs Zone information; Additional declarations as required (e.g., hazardous goods declaration).
Ensure all details entered in the electronic forms are accurate, as any errors or discrepancies can lead to delays in clearance or rejection of filings.
Upload the documents on the Indian Customs Electronic Commerce/ ICEGATE web portal.
Submit the documents via the EDI system once all forms have been filled out and verified.
Download and print the acknowledgement and the unique reference number generated (e.g., Bill of Entry Number or Shipping Bill Number).
Prepare payment requests and check for timely payments for processing shipments and customs clearance formalities.

Check the required customs and other related portals like shipping lines, Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Participative Government Agencies (PGAs), etc., to track the movement of submitted/approved documentation.
In case of changes in documentation or declarations, file an amendment request with ICEGATE and customs authorities, following their specified process.
Process the Goods for movement once the customs clearance is granted.

Keep copies of all documents, including the filed EDI forms, acknowledgement receipts, duty payment receipts, and clearance orders, as part of the company's records for compliance and maintenance for future reference.

pcs.pc_description: Interpret the project requirements for transportation in terms of material involved, dimensions, weight, volume, etc.
Work out the loading and unloading requirements, lashing requirements based on the centre of gravity, stability required, etc.
Identify the timelines available for arranging the transportation.
Support design team by providing inputs on different types of lashing, trailer bed specification, load bearing capacity of axles, etc.
Select the routes that require surveying and arrange for the necessary documents, equipment, and tools (camera, GPS, tackles, etc.). to undertake the survey.
Drive on the selected route at posted speed.
Identify and describe critical points such as road conditions, traffic composition, water crossings, canals, overhead electric wires, residential areas, railway gate crossings, road hazards, etc.

Identify narrow roads, low bridges, sharp turns, culverts, and other obstacles that require removing, shifting, widening, construction of the bypass, etc., for safe transportation of ODC/ project cargo.
Evaluate the strength of bridges/culverts (bridge strength engineering calculations) for safe movement of heavy ODC.
Design bypass as per cargo specification for safe transportation.
Perform engineering lashing calculations to secure ODC onto the hydraulic trailer/barge/ship for safe transportation of heavy cargo.
Perform engineering calculations related to the movement of project cargo through sea/river.
Support route survey with photographs and identify major milestones.
Describe the route plan along with the schedule for transportation considering weather conditions during transit (rainy season, winter, fog, etc.)
Detail clear reasons along with photographs for the non-feasibility of a particular route for transportation.
Estimate the budgetary details, such as the cost of civil work en route, detailing the civil work at each different destination.
Conduct a feasibility study for the construction of the ro-ro jetty if required.
Conduct roll off and roll on calculations of load transfer from barge to shore and vice versa.
Perform route surveys in strict adherence to the safety and health standards and regulations.

Map the routes in the software application and load other details relating to road conditions, speed to be maintained at different sections of the route, stops, permit required, etc. and simulate the travel plan.
Arrange for specialised equipment, such as heavy lift cranes, to handle the cargo.
Determine the best mode/mix of modes for transporting the cargo based on the route survey analysis simulation and other information.
Determine the safest route for transport with the least transit time as per the route survey analysis.
Confirm the right vehicle for transportation according to the cargo, such as Flatbed Trucks, Lowboy Trailers, Self-Propelled Modular Transporters (SPMTs), etc.
Determine the total number of axles to be deployed for the transportation of heavy ODCs through engineering calculations.
Prepare the entire transport methodology, including the transport process, deployment of axles and load calculations, lashing method details, etc.
Identify storage, laydown areas, and handling points at both the pickup and delivery locations.
Prepare budgets for transportation, including workforce, consumables, fuel, civil works, road8diversions, permits, etc.
Discuss the travel plan & budget with the Manager and obtain concurrence.
Arrange good quality authorised drivers and trailer operators for successful project completion.
Prepare a detailed list of all permits to be received based on route survey inputs.

Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies to obtain all required permits from RTD/PWD/ commercial tax/MORTH/electricity/ railways, government authorities or any other agencies which are required for the movement of cargo.
Assess the requirement of a police escort or traffic control, and if yes, follow the procedure to make the necessary arrangement.
Arrange for all special permits (in case cargo crossing railways, electricity lines to be disconnected, etc.).
Ensure that all goods are insured and covered for potential damage during transit.
Instruct drivers and trailer operators on routes to be taken, safety precautions to be undertaken, and emergency contacts along the route and provide them with necessary documentation.
Track the progress of the vehicle using GPS and Update relevant stakeholders on daily vehicle movement progress.
Perform periodic coordination for the supply of consumables/money for drivers.
Prepare for rescue operations if any consignment topples during transit.
Ensure the project cargo/ ODC is transported in compliance with ISO-14001 and ISO-18001 for environmental safety and occupational health safety.

pcs.pc_description: Submit documents required for customs clearance to customs officials as per requirements.
Respond to any queries and make note of any objections raised by customs officials on the cargo.
Escalate objections and remarks of customs officials to the (EXIM) supervisor and the customer as required.
Check that the packaging and material used are as per client's requirement and regulatory compliance.
Assist customs officer in conducting the inspection, and post inspection witness sealing of the container.
Coordinate with the custodian officials on receipt of goods for loading in the vessel.
Arrange for workforce and material handling equipment for the movement of goods.
Keep a record of shipment in the form of a daily status report & update the same to the customer & EXIM supervisor.
Collect, transmit and maintain records like photographs of seals and container number, cargo stuffing, etc., as records using data management devices.
Submit all signed hard copies and soft data for record filling.
Share a copy of the customs clearance documents with the shipper/ customs agents for further actions.
Collect feedback from customs officer and report it to the supervisor.
Follow up in the Indian Customs EDI Gateway (ICEGATE) and check if the bill of entry is approved.
Check the websites of various Participative Government Agencies (PGAs) to check for receipt of various clearances.
Check if the cargo is approved and released from customs and report the same.
Arrange for required information and related documents on the pending issues to get the cargo customs cleared.
Receive final clearance in the form of a Let Export Order (LEO)/ Out of Customs Charge (OCC).
Provide the required information and documents to the field executives.
Maintain records for clearance activities and shipment for the mandated duration as specified by EXIM regulations.
Assist in clarifying queries raised by customs official or arrange for additional documents from client/ shipper, if required.
Update cargo status in the portal with the assistance of the documentation executive.
Prepare invoices and process payment for accounting purposes in line with organisation requirements.
